title: Base Endurance Session - Return to Training

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Alternate between arching and rounding spine slowly, focus on mobility

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Switch between external hip rotation positions, hold briefly in each position

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Pull band apart with straight arms, squeeze shoulder blades together

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Easy pace warm-up, focus on technique over intensity

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Moderate steady pace, RPE 5-6. Focus on consistent stroke rate and good form

items.name: Rowing Machine
items.cues: Conversational pace, strong leg drive, maintain smooth rhythm

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Light weight, focus on depth and control. Build base strength for ski endurance

items.name: Bent-Over Row
items.cues: Moderate weight, squeeze shoulder blades. Essential for ski pulling motion

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Very easy pace, focus on cooling down gradually

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold stretch for 30 seconds each leg, focus on lengthening calf muscles

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow and controlled movements to release spine tension

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: 30 seconds each arm against wall, counteract rowing/skiing pulling motions

rationale: Starting with moderate endurance work after extended break to rebuild aerobic base safely
Combining ski erg and rowing machine to develop ski-specific endurance patterns for Vasaloppet preparation
Including foundational strength work at manageable loads to support long-distance skiing demands
